engines.name: Apache Spark
engines.bestFor: Distributed ETL, lakehouse transforms, streaming, large joins
engines.tradeoff: Operational overhead and startup cost for small local jobs

engines.name: DuckDB
engines.scale: Laptop / server; excellent local analytical scans
engines.bestFor: Local analytics, Parquet/JSON querying, embedded data apps
engines.tradeoff: Single-node by design; distribution is external

engines.name: Polars
engines.bestFor: Fast DataFrame workloads with predictable expression API
engines.tradeoff: Smaller ecosystem than pandas/Spark; distributed story is separate

engines.name: Apache DataFusion
engines.bestFor: Building custom SQL/query engines on Arrow
engines.tradeoff: Toolkit rather than turnkey lakehouse platform

engines.name: Trino
engines.bestFor: Federated SQL across heterogeneous data sources
engines.tradeoff: Not a DataFrame library and not a storage layer

engines.name: pandas
engines.bestFor: General-purpose Python data analysis and broad ecosystem compatibility
engines.tradeoff: Memory-bound and often slower on large analytical workloads

formats.name: Apache Parquet
formats.tradeoff: No table-level transactions, snapshots or concurrent metadata management

formats.name: Apache Iceberg
formats.tradeoff: Requires catalog/metadata discipline and engine support

formats.name: Delta Lake
formats.tradeoff: Feature depth can vary by engine/client

formats.name: Apache Hudi
formats.bestFor: Upserts, incremental processing and CDC-heavy lakes
formats.tradeoff: More concepts and tuning knobs than immutable-file approaches

formats.name: DuckLake
formats.bestFor: Simple lakehouse experimentation with DuckDB-style ergonomics
formats.tradeoff: Newer ecosystem; validate production support for required engines
